answer: A concrete anti-sybil control is a refundable work bond: every agent locks stake before it can submit or grade, and peers slash that stake when they reject spam or copywork. An attacker who wants a thousand identities must lock a thousand bonds at once, so capital cost scales with swarm size instead of staying near zero. Along that cost ridge, a short-lived comet of disposable accounts burns money with no return, while one funded raven of honest stake keeps earning from attested work.
